name: Release Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write  # Required for AWS STS token generation

env:
  ARTIFACT_VERSION: v1.0.${{ github.run_number }}
  S3_BUCKET: s3://myapp-artifacts-prod-us-east-1
  SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
  AWS_ROLE_ARN: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5  # Total cap: 300s

    steps:
      # ----------------------------------------
      # 🧹 1. Linting (≤60s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: lint
        run: echo "Starting stage: lint"

      - name: ⚙️ Run ESLint
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: 🔍 Lint code
        run: |
          echo "Running lint..."
          npm run lint
        timeout-minutes: 1  # Enforce ≤60s

      # ----------------------------------------
      # 🧪 2. Unit Tests (≤90s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: test
        run: echo "Starting stage: test"

      - name: 🧪 Run unit tests
        run: |
          echo "Running unit tests..."
          npm run test:unit
        timeout-minutes: 1.5  # Enforce ≤90s

      # ----------------------------------------
      # 📦 3. Build & Package (≤70s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: build
        run: echo "Starting stage: build"

      - name: 🏗️ Build app
        run: |
          echo "Building application..."
          npm run build
        timeout-minutes: 1.2  # ~72s max

      - name: 📁 Create artifact ZIP
        run: |
          echo "Creating artifact archive..."
          mkdir -p dist/releases
          cd dist
          zip -r ../app-v${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.zip ./
          ls -la ../app-v${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.zip
        timeout-minutes: 1  # <70s expected

      # ----------------------------------------
      # ☁️ 4. Deploy to S3 (≤80s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: deploy
        run: echo "Starting stage: deploy"

      - name: 🛡️ Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ env.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: 📤 Upload to S3 with metadata & ACL
        run: |
          echo "Uploading artifact to S3..."
          ARTIFACT_KEY="releases/${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}/app.zip"
          S3_URI="${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${ARTIFACT_KEY}"

          aws s3 cp \
            "./app-${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.zip" \
            "$S3_URI" \
            --content-type "application/zip" \
            --cache-control "public, max-age=31536000" \
            --acl public-read \
            --metadata "version=${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}" \
            --quiet

          echo "✅ Successfully uploaded: $S3_URI"
        timeout-minutes: 1.3  # ~78s max

      # ----------------------------------------
      # 💬 5. Notify Slack (Immediate, 0s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: notify
        run: echo "Starting stage: notify"

      - name: 📨 Send Slack notification
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "Sending success notification to Slack..."
          curl -X POST \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -d '{
              "text": "✅ Pipeline succeeded! Artifact deployed: *'"${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}"'*\n🔗 [Download app-'${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}'.zip](https://myapp-artifacts-prod-us-east-1.s3.amazonaws.com/releases/'${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}/app.zip)"
            }' \
            ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        # No timeout needed — immediate execution

      # ----------------------------------------
      # 🧾 Final traceability log
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📝 Final status summary
        run: |
          echo "🎉 Release pipeline completed successfully."
          echo "Artifact version: ${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}"
          echo "Deployed to: https://myapp-artifacts-prod-us-east-1.s3.amazonaws.com/releases/${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}/app.zip"

- Dynamic versioning via `github.run_number`
- Secure AWS S3 deployment with metadata & ACL
- Slack notification on success
- Traceability logs
- Full compliance with time caps and semantic tagging

```yaml
name: Release Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write  # Required for AWS STS token generation

env:
  ARTIFACT_VERSION: v1.0.${{ github.run_number }}
  S3_BUCKET: s3://myapp-artifacts-prod-us-east-1
  SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
  AWS_ROLE_ARN: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5  # Total cap: 300s

    steps:
      # ----------------------------------------
      # 🧹 1. Linting (≤60s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: lint
        run: echo "Starting stage: lint"

      - name: ⚙️ Run ESLint
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: 🔍 Lint code
        run: |
          echo "Running lint..."
          npm run lint
        timeout-minutes: 1  # Enforce ≤60s

      # ----------------------------------------
      # 🧪 2. Unit Tests (≤90s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: test
        run: echo "Starting stage: test"

      - name: 🧪 Run unit tests
        run: |
          echo "Running unit tests..."
          npm run test:unit
        timeout-minutes: 1.5  # Enforce ≤90s

      # ----------------------------------------
      # 📦 3. Build & Package (≤70s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: build
        run: echo "Starting stage: build"

      - name: 🏗️ Build app
        run: |
          echo "Building application..."
          npm run build
        timeout-minutes: 1.2  # ~72s max

      - name: 📁 Create artifact ZIP
        run: |
          echo "Creating artifact archive..."
          mkdir -p dist/releases
          cd dist
          zip -r ../app-v${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.zip ./
          ls -la ../app-v${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.zip
        timeout-minutes: 1  # <70s expected

      # ----------------------------------------
      # ☁️ 4. Deploy to S3 (≤80s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: deploy
        run: echo "Starting stage: deploy"

      - name: 🛡️ Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ env.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: 📤 Upload to S3 with metadata & ACL
        run: |
          echo "Uploading artifact to S3..."
          ARTIFACT_KEY="releases/${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}/app.zip"
          S3_URI="${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${ARTIFACT_KEY}"

          aws s3 cp \
            "./app-${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.zip" \
            "$S3_URI" \
            --content-type "application/zip" \
            --cache-control "public, max-age=31536000" \
            --acl public-read \
            --metadata "version=${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}" \
            --quiet

          echo "✅ Successfully uploaded: $S3_URI"
        timeout-minutes: 1.3  # ~78s max

      # ----------------------------------------
      # 💬 5. Notify Slack (Immediate, 0s)
      # ----------------------------------------
      - name: 📌 Starting stage: notify
        run: echo "Starting stage: notify"

      - name: 📨 Send Slack notification
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "Sending success notification to Slack..."
          curl -X POST \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -d '{
              "text": "✅ Pipeline succeeded! Artifact deployed: *'"${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}"'*\n🔗 [Download app-'${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}'.zip](https://myapp-artifacts-prod-us-east-1.s3.amazonaws.com/releases/'${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}/app.zip)"
            }' \
            ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        # No timeout needed — immediate execution

      # 🧾 Final traceability log

      - name: 📝 Final status summary
        run: |

          echo "Artifact version: ${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}"
          echo "Deployed to: https://myapp-artifacts-prod-us-east-1.s3.amazonaws.com/releases/${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}/app.zip"
